'''2008 Minnesota State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Sunday 27 July 2008 at Twin City Comics, the store that later hosted the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]], as the last of three events of the Minnesota Super Weekend organized by [[Garrett Larson]].<ref name="sf-21613-311565">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311565#p311565 MN Super weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 July 2008).</ref> [[Peter Jacobson]] received its bye into Day 2 of the World Championship.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

On 1 July 2008 Larson announced the Minnesota Super Weekend at Twin City Comics: the Minnesota Mini-Open on Friday 25 July at 1 pm, the [[2008 Bespin Regionals|Bespin Regional]] on Saturday 26 July at 11 am, which [[Michael Raveling|Mike Raveling]] offered to run because he already had a bye, and the state championship on Sunday 27 July at 11 am. Each event cost $10 and required decklists; the state championship carried one bye and used the three-judge system. There would be glass for the state champion and the Bespin regional champion, and Larson requested a virtual card design for the player with the highest combined finish in all three events. Prizes were to include trophies, rares, packs and tournament foils, and cash or Twin City Comics gift certificates depending on turnout.<ref name="sf-21075-311564">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311564#p311564 Minnesota Super Weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 July 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-21613-311565" /> All three events were [[Open]] format; Larson wrote that "Classic doesn't get much competetive play around here".<ref name="sf-21075-315480">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315480#p315480 Minnesota Super Weekend], deadbody (Garrett Larson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 July 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Minnesota<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Dates:''' 27 July 2008<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Time:''' 11:00 am<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]; decklists required; three-judge system<ref name="sf-21613-311565" /><ref name="sf-21075-315480" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Garrett Larson]]<ref name="sf-21613-311565" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Peter Jacobson]]<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />

== Results ==

No standings were posted in the Players Committee forum topics. The Players Committee's list of 2008 Day 2 bids gives the Minnesota bid to Peter Jacobson.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
